source.searchApiNote: dolphin/models returns 404; only direct known-repo listing works.

notes: All sizes, file names and sha256 values were measured live from the ModelScope file-listing API; none are from memory.,sizeGiB is the canonical size field (sizes match upstream GiB expectations exactly, e.g. 2497280256 B = 2.33 GiB). sizeGB is the same value in decimal GB for display only.,sha256 is null for sharded models: the API reports one sha256 per shard file (see shards[]), not a single hash for the merged model.,File names are case-inconsistent upstream (Qwen3 uses Qwen3-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf, Qwen2.5 uses qwen2.5-7b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf). Always use the exact fileName from this manifest.,minRamGB = weights x 1.12 + 0.35GB runtime; recommendedRamGB = weights x 1.35 + 0.9GB KV-cache headroom. Heuristic, tune per device.,Sharded naming is strictly -{5-digit index}-of-{5-digit total}.gguf, verified continuous 1..N across all 180 shard files.,Where a repo ships both a single-file and a sharded copy of the same quant, only one entry is kept (the sharded copy for sets over 3 GiB, since per-part resume is more robust on mobile). memoryTiers corrected by src/recommend/recommend.ts (see docs/tier-recommendation-fix.md). memoryTiers corrected & GiB-normalised by src/recommend/recommend.ts (docs/tier-recommendation-fix.md).
